title: Account Administration Standard: One Utility Pass-Through Service Account per Site Lease
content:
**Standard.** Every leased site carries exactly one Utility Pass-Through Service account, and an account belongs to exactly one lease. A utility account is opened for a lease only when that lease has no other utility account in pending start, active or final read pending status. Because a customer holds one open site lease at a time, a customer holds two utility accounts only while relocating — the old site's account final-reading or final-billed while the new site's account starts — and never more than two.

## Basis of the check when an account is opened

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Applies to | Opening a utility account for a site lease |
| Condition | The lease has no other utility account in pending start, active or final read pending status |
| Evidence | The company's own records: the lease each existing utility account serves and that account's status |
| Timing | Checked before the account is opened |
| Object | The same lease — accounts serving other leases are not counted |

## Status of an existing account for the same lease

| Status of the other utility account on the lease | Is it a second open account for that lease? |
|---|---|
| Pending start | Yes — the condition is not met |
| Active | Yes — the condition is not met |
| Final read pending | Yes — the condition is not met |
| Final billed, closed, or referred to collections | No — this status is not one of the three listed |

## Accounts per customer

The most utility accounts one customer holds at a time is 2. Worked through (hypothetical relocation): a resident moving between two sites has the old site's account in final read pending (or final billed) status while the new site's account is in pending start. That is two accounts, one per lease. A third account for the same customer does not arise, because the customer holds only one open site lease at a time.

**Points of judgement**

- *Two accounts on one customer profile?* Permitted only in the relocation pattern above, each account serving its own lease.
- *Two accounts serving one lease?* Never at the same time in pending start, active or final read pending status; every leased site carries exactly one utility account.
